<description>
Currently there is no test coverage for oversized CompactSize. This is fine, because a vector this large will already be rejected earlier by the P2P transport payload size check.

However, it would be good to still add test coverage:

* Removing the check would pass all tests.
* There is some accidental non-deterministic coverage through tx-deser "fuzzing", which hurts coverage reports, see https://github.com/corecheck/corecheck/pull/219#discussion_r4554170963.
* Having explicit end-to-end P2P coverage for such corrupt messages seems fine.
</description>
